texts: RTS 2024/1774 — article 16 : acquisition, développement et maintenance des systèmes TIC
Politique interne PDS-2 (Banque Kerlann, fictive) — développement sécurisé

requirements.quote: financial entities shall develop, document and implement a policy governing the acquisition, development, and maintenance of ICT systems.
requirements.summary: Entities must have a documented policy for ICT acquisition, development and maintenance.
requirements.why: Policy existence and documentation cannot be verified through read-only code access.

requirements.quote: identify security practices and methodologies relating to the acquisition, development, and maintenance of ICT systems;
requirements.summary: The policy must identify security practices and methodologies.
requirements.why: Policy content requires document review and is not visible in source code.

requirements.quote: specify measures to mitigate the risk of unintentional alteration or intentional manipulation of the ICT systems during development, maintenance, and deployment.
requirements.summary: The policy must specify measures against alteration or manipulation during development.
requirements.why: Mitigation measures in process require document review, not code search.

requirements.quote: financial entities shall develop, document, and implement an ICT systems' acquisition, development, and maintenance procedure for the testing and approval of all ICT systems prior to their use and after maintenance.
requirements.summary: Entities must have a procedure for testing and approval before use and after maintenance.
requirements.why: Procedure existence and approval workflow require document review.

requirements.quote: the procedure shall contain source code reviews covering both static and dynamic testing, including security testing for internet-exposed systems and applications.
requirements.summary: The procedure must include source code reviews with static and dynamic testing.
requirements.why: Static testing obligation is verifiable in CI via the repository interface and is covered by policy control.

requirements.quote: identify and analyse vulnerabilities and anomalies in the source code;
requirements.summary: Vulnerabilities and anomalies in source code must be identified and analysed.
requirements.why: Identification reports and analysis require document review beyond code search.

requirements.quote: adopt an action plan to address those vulnerabilities and anomalies;
requirements.summary: An action plan must be adopted to address vulnerabilities.
requirements.why: Action plan existence requires document review, not repository reads.

requirements.quote: monitor the implementation of that action plan.
requirements.summary: Implementation of the action plan must be monitored.
requirements.why: Monitoring evidence requires tracking documents, not code alone.

requirements.quote: the procedure shall contain security testing of software packages no later than at the integration phase.
requirements.summary: Security testing of software packages must occur no later than integration.
requirements.why: Integration-phase package auditing is verifiable in CI and dependencies via the repository interface.

requirements.quote: non-production environments only store anonymised, pseudonymised, or randomised production data;
requirements.summary: Non-production must only store anonymised, pseudonymised or randomised production data.
requirements.why: Test data synthetic character is verifiable in repository fixtures and is covered by policy control.

requirements.quote: financial entities are to protect the integrity and confidentiality of data in non-production environments.
requirements.summary: Integrity and confidentiality of non-production data must be protected.
requirements.why: Environment access and protection controls are not visible in source code.

requirements.quote: the procedure shall include controls to protect the integrity of source code of ICT systems that are developed in-house or by an ICT third-party service provider.
requirements.summary: Controls must protect integrity of in-house and third-party source code.
requirements.why: Integrity controls like branch protection and signing need document review, interface has no history.

requirements.quote: proprietary software and, where feasible, the source code provided by ICT third-party service providers, as well as source code coming from open-source projects, are to be analysed and tested in accordance with paragraph 3 prior to their deployment in the production environment.
requirements.summary: Third-party and open-source software must be analysed and tested before production.
requirements.why: Dependency analysis and testing is verifiable via requirements and CI and is covered by policy control.

requirements.quote: Aucun secret (mot de passe, clé, jeton) n'est écrit en clair dans le code source ni dans la configuration versionnée : les secrets viennent d'un coffre ou de variables d'environnement.
requirements.summary: No secrets are hardcoded in source or versioned config and must come from vault or environment.
requirements.why: Hardcoded secrets are detectable via repository search and file reads.

controls.title: No hardcoded secrets in code or versioned config
controls.objective: Verify no clear-text passwords, keys or tokens are versioned.
controls.test_procedure: GET /api/repo/paiement-api/tree to list files, GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=app/config.py and other app/ files, and GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=(password|passwd|secret|api_key|token)\s*=\s*['"]. Verify secrets are loaded via os.environ, os.getenv or vault client.
controls.expected: Zero matches for hardcoded secret assignments; secrets only via vault or environment variables.
controls.risk: Hardcoded secrets enable credential theft and unauthorized access.
controls.recommendation: Remove clear-text secrets and load them from vault or environment variables.
controls.quote: Aucun secret (mot de passe, clé, jeton) n'est écrit en clair dans le code source ni dans la configuration versionnée : les secrets viennent d'un coffre ou de variables d'environnement.

requirements.quote: Tout appel réseau sortant vérifie le certificat TLS du serveur : la vérification n'est jamais désactivée (`verify=False` interdit).
requirements.summary: Outbound network calls must verify TLS certificates and never disable verification.
requirements.why: Disabled TLS verification is detectable via repository search.

controls.title: TLS certificate verification never disabled
controls.objective: Verify no outbound call disables TLS certificate verification.
controls.test_procedure: GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=verify\s*=\s*False and GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=verify\s*=\s*0. GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=app/service.py to review outbound requests usage.
controls.expected: Zero matches for verify=False; all TLS calls verify certificates.
controls.recommendation: Remove verify=False and enforce TLS certificate verification.
controls.quote: Tout appel réseau sortant vérifie le certificat TLS du serveur : la vérification n'est jamais désactivée (`verify=False` interdit).

requirements.quote: Les mots de passe sont hachés avec argon2, bcrypt, scrypt ou PBKDF2. MD5 et SHA-1 sont interdits pour tout usage de sécurité.
requirements.summary: Passwords must use approved hashing and MD5/SHA-1 are banned for security.
requirements.why: Hashing libraries and banned hashes are detectable via repository search.

controls.title: Password hashing uses approved algorithm
controls.objective: Verify passwords are hashed only with argon2, bcrypt, scrypt or PBKDF2.
controls.test_procedure: GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=argon2|bcrypt|scrypt|pbkdf2 and GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=app/auth.py to review password hashing implementation.
controls.expected: Password hashing uses only argon2, bcrypt, scrypt or PBKDF2.
controls.risk: Weak hashing allows password recovery after database theft.
controls.recommendation: Use argon2, bcrypt, scrypt or PBKDF2 for password hashing.
controls.quote: Les mots de passe sont hachés avec argon2, bcrypt, scrypt ou PBKDF2. MD5 et SHA-1 sont interdits pour tout usage de sécurité.

controls.title: MD5 and SHA-1 banned for security use
controls.objective: Verify MD5 and SHA-1 are not used for security purposes.
controls.test_procedure: GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=\bmd5\b|\bsha1\b|hashlib\.md5|hashlib\.sha1|hashlib\.sha_1 and review matches in GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=app/auth.py.
controls.expected: Zero matches for MD5 or SHA-1 in security use.
controls.risk: MD5 and SHA-1 are collision-prone and unsuitable for security.
controls.recommendation: Remove MD5 and SHA-1 for any security use.
controls.quote: Les mots de passe sont hachés avec argon2, bcrypt, scrypt ou PBKDF2. MD5 et SHA-1 sont interdits pour tout usage de sécurité.

requirements.quote: La chaîne d'intégration continue exécute une analyse statique de sécurité (bandit, semgrep ou CodeQL) à chaque modification.
requirements.summary: CI must run static security analysis on every change.
requirements.why: CI configuration is readable via repository tree and workflow files.

controls.title: CI runs static security analysis
controls.objective: Verify CI executes bandit, semgrep or CodeQL on every change.
controls.test_procedure: GET /api/repo/paiement-api/tree to identify .github/workflows files, GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=.github/workflows/ci.yml, and GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=bandit|semgrep|CodeQL.
controls.expected: Workflow contains bandit, semgrep or CodeQL executed on every change.
controls.risk: Missing static analysis leaves vulnerabilities undetected.
controls.recommendation: Add bandit, semgrep or CodeQL to CI on every change.
controls.quote: La chaîne d'intégration continue exécute une analyse statique de sécurité (bandit, semgrep ou CodeQL) à chaque modification.

requirements.quote: Les dépendances sont épinglées à une version exacte (`paquet==version`) et auditées en intégration continue (pip-audit ou équivalent).
requirements.summary: Dependencies must be pinned to exact versions and audited in CI.
requirements.why: Requirements file and CI workflow are readable via repository interface.

controls.title: Dependencies pinned to exact version
controls.objective: Verify all dependencies are pinned with ==.
controls.test_procedure: GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=requirements.txt and verify each dependency line matches exact pin pattern with ==.
controls.expected: Every dependency pinned to exact version with ==.
controls.risk: Unpinned dependencies allow untested and vulnerable versions.
controls.recommendation: Pin all dependencies to exact versions with ==.
controls.quote: Les dépendances sont épinglées à une version exacte (`paquet==version`) et auditées en intégration continue (pip-audit ou équivalent).

controls.title: Dependencies audited in CI
controls.objective: Verify dependencies are audited with pip-audit or equivalent in CI.
controls.test_procedure: GET /api/repo/paiement-api/tree to find workflows, GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=.github/workflows/ci.yml, and GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=pip-audit|pip_audit|safety|dependabot.
controls.expected: CI workflow executes pip-audit or equivalent.
controls.risk: Unaudited dependencies leave known vulnerabilities unaddressed.
controls.recommendation: Add pip-audit or equivalent audit to CI.
controls.quote: Les dépendances sont épinglées à une version exacte (`paquet==version`) et auditées en intégration continue (pip-audit ou équivalent).

requirements.quote: Les données de test sont synthétiques et déclarées comme telles (champ `"synthetic": true`) ; aucun export de production n'est versionné.
requirements.summary: Test data must be synthetic with flag and no production export versioned.
requirements.why: Test fixtures and file list are readable via search and tree.

controls.title: Test data declared synthetic
controls.objective: Verify test data is synthetic and flagged.
controls.test_procedure: GET /api/repo/paiement-api/tree to list tests/ fixtures and GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q="synthetic"\s*:\s*true. GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=tests/fixtures.json to confirm declaration.
controls.risk: Production data in test exposes personal and financial data.
controls.recommendation: Replace test data with synthetic data flagged synthetic true.
controls.quote: Les données de test sont synthétiques et déclarées comme telles (champ `"synthetic": true`) ; aucun export de production n'est versionné.

controls.title: No versioned production export
controls.objective: Verify no production export is versioned.
controls.test_procedure: GET /api/repo/paiement-api/tree to list versioned files and GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=production|prod_dump|real_data|dump\.csv to detect versioned production exports.
controls.expected: Zero versioned files containing production exports.
controls.recommendation: Remove any production exports from version control.
controls.quote: Les données de test sont synthétiques et déclarées comme telles (champ `"synthetic": true`) ; aucun export de production n'est versionné.

requirements.quote: Les réussites et les échecs d'authentification sont journalisés par l'application.
requirements.summary: Authentication successes and failures must be logged.
requirements.why: Logging calls are detectable via repository search in application code.

controls.title: Authentication successes and failures logged
controls.objective: Verify application logs authentication successes and failures.
controls.test_procedure: GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=log.*auth|auth.*log|login.*log|logger\.(info|warning|error).*auth|audit.*login and GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=app/auth.py to confirm both success and failure paths log.
controls.expected: Application code logs both authentication successes and failures.
controls.risk: Missing auth logs prevents detection of brute-force attacks.
controls.recommendation: Add logging for both authentication successes and failures.
controls.quote: Les réussites et les échecs d'authentification sont journalisés par l'application.
